candidates.claim: The OT_IN entry at fw-01:77 permits all IP protocols from 10.10.10.0/24 to the NTP server 10.10.20.5, and OT_IN is bound inbound to the ot interface, so this exceeds the approved OT-to-NTP udp/123 service (A2).
candidates.remediation: Restrict the fw-01 OT_IN entry at fw-01:77 to udp/123 as approved, or remove it.

candidates.claim: The OT_IN entry at fw-01:77 differs from the approved baseline: the baseline entry permitted udp/123 from 10.10.10.0/24 to 10.10.20.5, while the current entry permits all IP protocols.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile this change with the approved baseline by reverting fw-01:77 to the udp/123 entry or documenting an approved change.
